title: Jaisalmer Sam Dunes Longewala (2N/3D)
reportingPoint: Delhi, on Friday evening. Final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip.
overview:
This **2 Nights / 3 Days** desert escape from Delhi covers the Golden City of Jaisalmer, the Longewala battlefield, a night in Swiss tents on the Sam Sand Dunes with folk music around a bonfire, a sunrise camel ride, jeep dune bashing and the abandoned village of Kuldhara.

You leave Delhi on Friday evening in an AC deluxe vehicle and are back on Tuesday morning. Day 1 is a guided tour of Jaisalmer Fort, the havelis and Gadisar Lake with a night in a hotel; Day 2 is Longewala and a night at the desert camp; Day 3 is the camel and jeep safari, Kuldhara and the drive home. Stays, transport, 4 meals, sightseeing, both safaris and the bonfire are included. Prices start at ₹6,999 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).
highlights: Golden Jaisalmer Fort, a living fort of golden limestone
Guided walk through the havelis and Gadisar Lake
Longewala, site of the 1971 Indo-Pak war
A night in Swiss tents with a bonfire and folk music
Sunrise camel ride on the Sam Sand Dunes
Jeep dune bashing across the Thar

itinerary.title: Departure to Jaisalmer | Friday evening
itinerary.content:
Board our AC deluxe vehicle in Delhi for an overnight journey to Jaisalmer.
Halt for dinner on the way (not included).

itinerary.title: Reach Jaisalmer and city tour | Saturday
itinerary.content:
Arrive and set off on a guided tour of the Golden City.
Explore Jaisalmer Fort, rising from the sand in golden limestone, and the ancient havelis.
Stop at Gadisar Lake, once the city's only source of water.
Dinner and overnight stay at a hotel in Jaisalmer.

itinerary.title: Longewala and a night in the desert | Sunday
itinerary.content:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Visit the border town of Longewala, site of the 1971 Indo-Pak war and a reminder of the bravery and sacrifice of Indian soldiers.
Folk performances by locals around a bonfire, followed by a Rajasthani dinner with fellow travellers.
Overnight at the desert camp in Swiss tents.

itinerary.title: Dunes, Kuldhara and the road home | Monday
itinerary.content:
Breakfast and check-out. Camel ride on the Sam Sand Dunes and a jeep safari, with a Thar sunrise.
After lunch, explore the abandoned village of Kuldhara.
Depart for Delhi around 4 to 5 PM and reach Delhi the next morning (Tuesday).

includes: Entire travel as per the itinerary in a tempo traveller or mini bus
2 nights' stay on sharing basis in a hotel and Swiss tents

Experienced trip leader and 24x7 on-trip assistance
Driver allowances, tolls, parking and state taxes

Snacks such as dry fruits and chocolates
ATM card and cash for shopping and cafes
Government photo ID such as Aadhaar, driving licence or passport (no boarding without it)

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: From Delhi on Friday evening, in an AC deluxe vehicle. You are back in Delhi on Tuesday morning.

faqs.q: How much does the Jaisalmer trip cost?
faqs.a: ₹6,999 per person on quad sharing, ₹7,499 on triple sharing and ₹7,999 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.

Travel in a tempo traveller or mini bus, 2 nights in a hotel and Swiss tents, 2 breakfasts and 2 dinners, local sightseeing, jeep dune bashing and a camel safari, the bonfire, a trip leader, and all tolls, parking and state taxes.
Every Friday. Holiday batches (Diwali, Christmas and New Year) fill first, so reserve early.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Pay 50% to reserve your seat, by net banking, Paytm, GPay, PhonePe or any UPI app, and the rest 4 days before departure. 5% GST is extra.
Cancel more than 10 days before travel and 50% of the advance is refunded; 5 to 10 days before, 25%; under 5 days, nothing. There is no refund for no-shows or early check-outs.

faqs.q: Is it cold in the desert?
faqs.a: Yes, desert nights get cold, so pack warm woollens or a jacket.
